legend: This case arose in a 48-year-old man with a lesion of the anterior maxilla ulcerating the gingiva.

A 48-year-old man with a lesion of anterior maxilla ulcerating the gingiva. On microscopy, there is a proliferation of spindle (shown here) and epithelioid cells (Fig. <<#54481>>) with distinct nucleoli, high mitotic index, and scant anisokaryosis (Fig. <<54482>>). This tumour was associated with a FUS::TFCP2 fusion.

diagnosis: Structure of the FET-TFCP2 fusion proteins
legend: Schematic of the protein domains of FUS, EWSR1, TFCP2, FUS::TFCP2, and EWSR1::TFCP2 (not precisely to scale). CP2, conserved region in CP2 transcription factor family; NES, nuclear export signal; NLS, nuclear localization signal; QGSY, Gln-Gly-Ser-Tyr–rich region; RGG, Arg-Gly-Gly–rich motif; RRM, RNA recognition motif; Znf, zinc finger motif.

diagnosis: Uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) analysis of rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) families
legend: UMAP analysis of the transcriptomes of RMS families including alveolar RMS (yellow), embryonal RMS (light green), spindle cell RMSs (most of them being associated with VGLL2 rearrangements; dark green), and RMS with MYOD1 mutations (orange). TFCP2-rearranged RMSs are highlighted in red, forming a distinct subfamily.
